Name: RESIST_CORRECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Raises a character's status ailment resistance each time that ailment triggers on it. Chosen per ailment by the NpcParam Resist Correction rows (Poison, Scarlet Rot, Blood Loss, Death Blight, Frostbite, Sleep, Madness). After the Nth trigger (counted per ailment, capped at 5) the resistance becomes the character's normal resistance × Multiplier N + Additional Resistance N, and the build-up meter refills to the new value. Values don't stack: each trigger count uses its own pair.

Fields.Name: Additional Resistance - First Activation
Fields.Description: Added to the resistance after the first trigger, after the multiplier. 0: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Additional Resistance - Second Activation
Fields.Description: Added to the resistance after the second trigger, after the multiplier. Replaces the first-trigger bonus (not added to it).

Fields.Name: Additional Resistance - Third Activation
Fields.Description: Added to the resistance after the third trigger, after the multiplier. Replaces the earlier bonus (not added to it).

Fields.Name: Additional Resistance - Fourth Activation
Fields.Description: Added to the resistance after the fourth trigger, after the multiplier. Replaces the earlier bonus (not added to it).

Fields.Name: Additional Resistance - Fifth Activation
Fields.Description: Added to the resistance after the fifth and every later trigger, after the multiplier. Replaces the earlier bonus (not added to it).

Fields.Name: Resistance Multiplier - First Activation
Fields.Description: Multiplies the character's normal resistance after the first trigger. 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Resistance Multiplier - Second Activation
Fields.Description: Multiplies the character's normal resistance after the second trigger (not the already raised value). 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Resistance Multiplier - Third Activation
Fields.Description: Multiplies the character's normal resistance after the third trigger (not the already raised value). 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Resistance Multiplier - Fourth Activation
Fields.Description: Multiplies the character's normal resistance after the fourth trigger (not the already raised value). 1: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Resistance Multiplier - Fifth Activation
Fields.Description: Multiplies the character's normal resistance after the fifth and every later trigger (not the already raised value). 1: unchanged.
